Coram : BELA M. TRIVEDI, PANKAJ MITHAL
Issue for Consideration The appellants were dismissed/discharged from service on the ground that at the time of their enrollment in the Army through Maratha Light Infantry Regimental Centre under the Unit Headquarters Quota in December, 2009 they had produced false verification were found to be manipulated and false. The points which arise for consideration are: (i) Whether the appellants were enrolled/recruited by giving benefit of relationship with the servicemen/ex-servicemen; (ii) Whether the appellants have produced any relationship certificate(s);
